THE HEIR IN THE RAIN
EPISODE 2 - "THE ENVELOPE"

[00:00] HARISH DESAI: It's about your father.
[00:03] Mira freezes.
[00:05] INT. DESAI'S CAR - NIGHT - MOVING
[00:07] Rain streaks the windows. Mira sits stiffly, clutching the cracked frame.
[00:11] MIRA: My father walked out before I was born. Whatever he wants, the answer is no.
[00:17] DESAI: He didn't walk out, Miss Kapoor. He was never told you existed.
[00:22] Desai hands her a thick cream envelope sealed with red wax. The seal shows an anchor and the letters R.S.
[00:28] DESAI: Everything is in here. Read it when you are ready.
[00:32] Mira puts the envelope in her bag without opening it.
[00:35] MIRA: Stop the car. I'll walk from here.
[00:38] INT. MEHTA GROUP - DESIGN OFFICE - DAY
[00:40] Mira, a bruise on her cheek, sits at a cramped desk sketching a hotel lobby.
[00:45] Tanya walks in carrying Mira's portfolio.
[00:48] TANYA: Mira, Mrs. Mehta wants to see the lobby designs. I'll take them up for you.
[00:53] MIRA: Those are mine. I'll present them myself.
[00:56] Leela Mehta enters with two security guards.
[00:59] MRS. MEHTA: You won't present anything. You're fired.
[01:03] MIRA: On what grounds?
[01:05] MRS. MEHTA: Theft. Tanya found our client files on your laptop.
[01:10] Mira turns to Tanya. Tanya won't meet her eyes.
[01:13] MIRA: Tanya. Tell her that's a lie.
[01:16] TANYA: I'm sorry, Mira. I had to tell the truth.
[01:20] A guard dumps Mira's belongings into a cardboard box in front of the whole office.
[01:25] MRS. MEHTA: And the new head of design is Ms. Sethi. Congratulations, Tanya.
[01:30] The office applauds. Tanya smiles.
[01:33] EXT. MEHTA GROUP TOWER - STEPS - DAY
[01:35] Mira sits on the steps with her box. Her phone buzzes. A text from Arjun: "Don't call me for a while."
[01:42] She laughs bitterly, then pulls the cream envelope out of her bag.
[01:46] She breaks the red wax seal.
[01:49] Inside: a legal document and an old photograph of a young woman holding a baby. On the back: "Asha and our daughter. V."
[01:57] MIRA: Asha... that's my mother.
[02:00] She unfolds the document. Her eyes widen. Her hands start to shake.
[02:05] MIRA: (whispering) This can't be true.
[02:09] CUT TO BLACK.
